THE_CORRECTION.as_written: 'H1 ... is REJECTED' / 'H1 ... is REJECTED. C_A's mean is not just non-significant, it is in the WRONG direction for H1'.
THE_CORRECTION.why_that_overstates: a null result is not proof of a zero effect. C_A = -0.078 [-0.266, +0.109] still PERMITS a modest positive inference-time contribution from geometry -- the interval's upper end is +0.109, which is not nothing. Writing 'REJECTED' unqualified invites a reader to hear 'proven zero', which the data does not support and which a reviewer would correctly attack.
THE_CORRECTION.corrected_wording: H1 is OPERATIONALLY REJECTED AS THE LOAD-BEARING EXPLANATION for the recovered Pole-A specialization -- not proven to be a zero effect.
what_supports_the_operational_rejection: C_A = -0.078 [-0.266, +0.109]: no detectable erosion of the specialization gap when geometry is deleted, point estimate wrong-signed for H1
delta_A_zero = +0.359 [+0.203, +0.516]: the gap not only survives geometry deletion, it independently clears the pass criterion WITHOUT geometry
L_A = -0.016 [-0.078, +0.047] and L_B = +0.063 [-0.094, +0.219]: no detectable absolute-capability cost on either policy
POLE_B_ENTITY_UTILIZATION: an independent, open-loop measurement (per-decision footprint ~4% of input norm, ~97% greedy-action agreement, symmetric between the passing and failing regime)
THE_CORRECTION.the_precise_claim: inference-time entity geometry is a very poor explanation for the recovered specialization. A modest inference-time contribution is not excluded; a LOAD-BEARING one is.

WHY_THIS_DISTINCTION_IS_KEPT: every downstream document -- and any eventual write-up -- inherits this sentence. 'Operationally rejected as the load-bearing explanation' is defensible against the actual interval; 'rejected' is not. The experiment was powered to detect a load-bearing effect, not to establish equivalence, and the record should say only what the design can carry.
NO_OTHER_CHANGE: the numbers, contracts, branch assignment (branch 1), and the H2/H3 next-step reasoning in POLE_A_GEOMETRY_ABLATION_READING.json are unchanged and remain correct.
